description: Top Class Education (National Scholarship, Part B) for ST students in notified premier institutions

income_ceiling.source: National Fellowship & Scholarship guidelines 2021-22 to 2025-26, Part B section 2.2
income_ceiling.note: The old Python decision table used Rs 8,00,000; it has been deleted. The official guideline says Rs 6.0 lakh.

rules.failure_reason: Student must belong to a Scheduled Tribe.
rules.failure_reason_hi: छात्र को अनुसूचित जनजाति से संबंधित होना चाहिए।

rules.failure_reason: Family annual income exceeds the scheme ceiling.
rules.failure_reason_hi: परिवार की वार्षिक आय योजना की सीमा से अधिक है।

rules.failure_reason: Not admitted to a notified premier institution.
rules.failure_reason_hi: अधिसूचित प्रमुख संस्थान में प्रवेश नहीं है।

rules.failure_reason: Student must not hold another active MoTA scholarship.
rules.failure_reason_hi: छात्र के पास कोई अन्य सक्रिय MoTA छात्रवृत्ति नहीं होनी चाहिए।

tuition_fee.source: National Fellowship & Scholarship guidelines 2021-22 to 2025-26, Part B section 2.5
tuition_fee.official_document_value: full for Government institutes; ceiling Rs 2.50 lakh/year for private

living_expenses.source: National Fellowship & Scholarship guidelines 2021-22 to 2025-26, Part B section 2.5

book_grant.source: National Fellowship & Scholarship guidelines 2021-22 to 2025-26, Part B section 2.5

computer_allowance.source: National Fellowship & Scholarship guidelines 2021-22 to 2025-26, Part B section 2.5
